messages:
sam: HelionHealth RFI landed. They want a capability matrix, POC ops plan, deployment options (hosted / dedicated / private), HIPAA/BAA note, and a 3-month pricing ballpark for 150M tokens/month + 20k embeddings. 48h turnaround. Who owns which pieces?

iris: Ill take the capability matrix. Procurement asked explicit rows for: quantization profiles (8/4-bit), adaptive batching & KV cache, automated fallback, audit logs, and SSO (SAML/OIDC/FIDO).

lina: Ill draft the POC ops plan and the deployment mapping. Will include a canary example, SLA ramp (trial -> full POC), and an "edge GPU" note for customer-provided hardware.

noah: Ill handle security answers. Quick summary: Private supports BYOK + optional HSM; Dedicated can integrate customer KMS via key policy; Hosted uses managed keys but we can enable CMK for enterprise plans. Ill attach SOC2 Type II and our BAA template.

finbot: (uploaded) helion_rfi_assets_v1.zip - capability_matrix.xlsx, rfi_responses.md, poc_ops_runbook.pdf, pricing_estimate.csv

sam: Helion also asked: 1) Can the POC run in their Azure subscription? 2) Do we ship model weights?

iris: Short answers: Azure deploy: Hosted = no; Dedicated = possible with VNet peering + reserved nodes; Private = yes (customer VNet or on-prem). Model weights: we do not distribute Redwood-managed performance weights; open-catalog model weights can be provided per license.

lina: Ops snippet to include in runbook:
```
route: helion-poc
model: redwood-7b-quant
batching: adaptive
canary: {pct:5, duration:24h}
rollback: latency>1.8s || errors>0.8%
```

sam: Target to send bundle tomorrow 08:30 PST after Finance approves the POC discount. Iris/Lina/Noah please finalize attachments by EOD. :thumbsup:
